input.title: Restore source audio windows and collision sound timing
input.body:
## Summary

Restore the original audio windows and the source owners of music/hit timing.

```text
Supplied MP3 → decode at tag rate → seek/count window → local PCM WAV → ready assets
Shared stage → accepted music fade/mute state → browser playback
Collision callback → shared World hit gate → sound event → ten general sound slots
World.Run succeeds → advance hit gate; interrupted Run → retain it
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** Sound561 decoded to235.102ms because playback ignored its source timing.
  **After:** The original seek1674/count2304 window produces104.4898ms at22050Hz. All18 native sounds prepare before assets become ready. The production helper's bounded firing waveform correlates **0.99999766** with captured original mixed PCM; this is not whole-audio equality.
- **Before:** A second RAF clock drove music, fade-time requests replaced the accepted target, and muted route changes replaced remembered music.
  **After:** Music follows the shared stage and source request/mute rules. Public original input confirms the remembered-menu quirk after entering a game while muted; three deterministic transport scenarios now select the source track.
- **Before:** Generic Damage emitted hit audio after protection, while the browser throttled it.
  **After:** Virtual collision callbacks own hit audio and forward the source enemy argument. Silent overrides, protected contacts, turret/builder dispatch, pause/zero-reset and skipped listener tails share one World cooldown. Six baseline regressions fail before the fix; all nine final combat cases pass.
- Formatting, TypeScript, **771 unit tests / 7,561 assertions**, production build and **thirteen distinct affected mock/native browser cases without skips** pass. These include actual media resume/volleys, all18 decoded windows, NPC/Healer lifecycle, projectile order and turret protection.
- Original media/captures remain local and ignored. Decoder/resampler and loop-edge equality, complete same-track scene re-entry, source shock/charging dispatch and full original/Adobe/game parity remain explicit work.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

No save migration, dependencies, bundled original media or deployment changes.

**Blast Radius:** audio

Native asset preparation now decodes/crops audio before readiness. Shared music timing and collision sound dispatch change; gameplay health/damage rules and the ten-slot browser pool remain covered.
